## Summary
Build the dead letter queue UI and manual retry API that gives admins visibility into failed Inngest pipeline steps (C04) and the ability to retry them, preventing silent data loss in the assessment generation pipeline.

## User story
As an admin, I want to see all failed pipeline steps in a dead letter queue and retry them manually, so that no assessment items are silently lost due to transient failures.

## Why this matters
**C04 Production Finding**: Without a dead letter queue, failed Inngest pipeline steps disappear silently. This means:
- Assessment items that fail during generation are never retried
- Coverage gaps appear with no explanation
- Admins have no way to know something went wrong until students report missing content
- The pipeline appears healthy while silently losing data

This story provides the safety net: every failure is captured, visible, and retryable.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Dead letter queue page shows all failed pipeline step records
- [ ] Each entry displays: function name, step name, error message, failure timestamp, attempt count, payload preview
- [ ] Admin can retry a single dead letter entry (re-sends Inngest event with original payload)
- [ ] Admin can bulk-retry all entries for a specific function
- [ ] Retry confirmation dialog shows the entry details before executing
- [ ] After retry, entry status changes to 'retrying' then 'resolved' (on success) or increments attempt count (on re-failure)
- [ ] Dead letters are scoped to admin's institution_id
- [ ] Dead letter entries are written by Inngest onFailure handlers (schema provided here, writes happen in pipeline stories)
- [ ] Maximum retry attempts configurable (default: 3) — entries exceeding max show "permanently failed" status

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Rule 1 (C05) | If dead letter entries reference Neo4j operations, use neo4jQuery wrapper for any re-sync |
| Rule 6 (G08) | Retry writes Supabase status FIRST, then re-triggers Inngest event. Inngest failure never blocks status update |
| Data Layer | createServerClient() in API routes for dead letter queries and status updates |
| Data Layer (AP-16) | Row<'dead_letter_queue'> from @journey/db/client |
| Rule 3 | Promise.allSettled for bulk retry operations — one failure must not block others |
| Atomic Design | DeadLetterQueue is an organism, RetryConfirmDialog is a molecule (no service calls) |

## Schema changes
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.dead_letter_queue (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.institutions(id),
  function_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- Inngest function ID, e.g. 'journey/p1-generate-items'
  step_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- Inngest step name, e.g. 'generate-batch'
  event_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- Original Inngest event name
  event_data JSONB NOT NULL, -- Original event payload for retry
  error_message TEXT NOT NULL,
  error_stack TEXT,
  attempt_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  max_attempts INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'failed' CHECK (status IN ('failed', 'retrying', 'resolved', 'permanently_failed')),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  last_retried_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  retried_by UUID REFERENCES public.profiles(id)
);

ALTER TABLE public.dead_letter_queue ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Admins can read dead letters for own institution"
  ON public.dead_letter_queue FOR SELECT
  USING (institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid())
    AND (SELECT role FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()) = 'admin');
CREATE POLICY "Admins can update dead letter status for own institution"
  ON public.dead_letter_queue FOR UPDATE
  USING (institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid())
    AND (SELECT role FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()) = 'admin');

CREATE INDEX idx_dead_letter_queue_status ON public.dead_letter_queue (institution_id, status, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_dead_letter_queue_function ON public.dead_letter_queue (function_name, status);
```

## Neo4j nodes created/modified
None — dead letter queue is Supabase-only. Retried events may trigger Neo4j writes in the pipeline functions they re-invoke, but that is handled by those functions, not this story.

## Neo4j edges created/traversed
None.

## Inngest event context
- Retry action sends: `inngest.send({ name: entry.event_name, data: entry.event_data })`
- This re-triggers the original pipeline function that failed
- onFailure handlers in pipeline functions are responsible for WRITING to dead_letter_queue (not this story's scope — this story only READS and RETRIES)

## API contract
```
GET /app/api/admin/pipelines/dead-letters?status=failed&function_name=X&page=1&limit=50
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response 200: {
  data: {
    entries: Array<{
      id: string, function_name: string, step_name: string,
      error_message: string, attempt_count: number, max_attempts: number,
      status: 'failed' | 'retrying' | 'resolved' | 'permanently_failed',
      event_data: object, created_at: string, last_retried_at: string | null
    }>,
    total: number,
    page: number
  },
  error: null
}

POST /app/api/admin/pipelines/dead-letters/[id]/retry
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response 200: { data: { retried: true, new_status: 'retrying' }, error: null }
Response 400: { data: null, error: { code: 'MAX_RETRIES_EXCEEDED', message: 'Entry has exceeded maximum retry attempts' } }
Response 404: { data: null, error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: string } }
Response 401: { data: null, error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: string } }
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/admin/services/DeadLetterService.ts
import { createServerClient, Row } from '@journey/db/client';
import { inngest } from '@/inngest/client';

type DeadLetter = Row<'dead_letter_queue'>;

export class DeadLetterService {
  async retryEntry(entryId: string): Promise<void> {
    const supabase = createServerClient();

    // Read the entry
    const { data: entry, error } = await supabase
      .from('dead_letter_queue')
      .select('*')
      .eq('id', entryId)
      .single();
    if (error || !entry) throw new Error('Dead letter entry not found');

    // Check max retries
    if (entry.attempt_count >= entry.max_attempts) {
      await supabase
        .from('dead_letter_queue')
        .update({ status: 'permanently_failed' })
        .eq('id', entryId);
      throw new Error('Maximum retry attempts exceeded');
    }

    // Rule 6: Supabase FIRST — update status before triggering Inngest
    const { error: updateError } = await supabase
      .from('dead_letter_queue')
      .update({
        status: 'retrying',
        attempt_count: entry.attempt_count + 1,
        last_retried_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq('id', entryId);
    if (updateError) throw updateError;

    // THEN trigger Inngest retry (failure here does NOT block — status already updated)
    try {
      await inngest.send({
        name: entry.event_name,
        data: { ...entry.event_data, dead_letter_id: entryId },
      });
    } catch (inngestError) {
      // Log but don't throw — Supabase status is already 'retrying'
      console.error('Inngest retry send failed:', inngestError);
    }
  }

  async bulkRetry(functionName: string): Promise<{ retried: number; failed: number }> {
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    const { data: entries } = await supabase
      .from('dead_letter_queue')
      .select('id')
      .eq('function_name', functionName)
      .eq('status', 'failed');

    if (!entries) return { retried: 0, failed: 0 };

    // Rule 3: Promise.allSettled for batch operations
    const results = await Promise.allSettled(
      entries.map((e) => this.retryEntry(e.id))
    );

    const retried = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'fulfilled').length;
    const failed = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'rejected').length;
    return { retried, failed };
  }
}

// app/(admin)/dead-letters/page.tsx — < 30 lines
import { DeadLetterQueue } from '@/features/admin/components/DeadLetterQueue';
export default function DeadLettersPage() {
  return <DeadLetterQueue />;
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ Rule 6: Inngest send BEFORE Supabase status update
await inngest.send({ name: entry.event_name, data: entry.event_data }); // BANNED first
await supabase.from('dead_letter_queue').update({ status: 'retrying' }); // Too late if Inngest fails
// ✓ Supabase status update FIRST, then Inngest send

// ✗ Rule 3: Promise.all for bulk retry
await Promise.all(entries.map(retry)); // BANNED — one failure kills all retries
// ✓ Use: Promise.allSettled(entries.map(retry))

// ✗ AP-16: Hand-written interface
interface DeadLetter { id: string; function_name: string; } // BANNED
// ✓ Use: Row<'dead_letter_queue'>

// ✗ Non-atomic status update (Rule 11 pattern)
const entry = await getEntry(id);
entry.attempt_count += 1; // read-modify-write race condition
await updateEntry(entry);
// ✓ Use: .update({ attempt_count: entry.attempt_count + 1 }) in single query
```

None — dead letter entries are created by pipeline onFailure handlers. For testing, seed test entries directly.

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E02/E02-S07.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('GET /api/admin/pipelines/dead-letters returns failed entries', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get('/api/admin/pipelines/dead-letters?status=failed');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const body = await res.json();
  expect(body.data).toHaveProperty('entries');
  expect(body.data).toHaveProperty('total');
  expect(Array.isArray(body.data.entries)).toBe(true);
});

test('GET /api/admin/pipelines/dead-letters supports function_name filter', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get('/api/admin/pipelines/dead-letters?function_name=journey/p1-generate-items');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const body = await res.json();
  body.data.entries.forEach((entry: any) => {
    expect(entry.function_name).toBe('journey/p1-generate-items');
  });
});

test('POST /api/admin/pipelines/dead-letters/[id]/retry retries a failed entry', async ({ request }) => {
  // Get a failed entry first
  const listRes = await request.get('/api/admin/pipelines/dead-letters?status=failed');
  const { data } = await listRes.json();
  if (data.entries.length > 0) {
    const entryId = data.entries[0].id;
    const res = await request.post(`/api/admin/pipelines/dead-letters/${entryId}/retry`);
    expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
    const body = await res.json();
    expect(body.data.retried).toBe(true);
    expect(body.data.new_status).toBe('retrying');
  }
});

test('POST /api/admin/pipelines/dead-letters/[id]/retry returns 400 for max retries exceeded', async ({ request }) => {
  // This requires a test entry with attempt_count >= max_attempts
  // Seeded via test fixture
  const res = await request.post('/api/admin/pipelines/dead-letters/test-max-retries-id/retry');
  expect([400, 404]).toContain(res.status());
});

test('POST /api/admin/pipelines/dead-letters/[id]/retry returns 404 for invalid id', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post('/api/admin/pipelines/dead-letters/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/retry');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(404);
});

test('GET /api/admin/pipelines/dead-letters returns 401 when unauthenticated', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get('/api/admin/pipelines/dead-letters');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(401);
});
```
